text:
mira: quick heads-up 17 4a1 partner integration fired a big multipart embed payload that hit our router. we saw a spike in 413s and a lot of noisy retries.
ben: link to logs? which route?
mira: /v1/embeds/customer-default. payload had mixed dims (512, 512, 1024) and ~1.2MB total. runtime fast-failed with 413 payload_too_large + generic text.
igor: current behavior: we reject mixed-dim batches and size-exceeding batches with the same 413. awful for clients. they can't programmatically fix it.
rachael: proposal: introduce a structured guidance error for these cases with minimal surface area. fields: code, message, hint {type, suggested_split, max_batch_bytes, expected_latency_delta}. no routing ids.
ben: love. also rate-limit suggestion issuance per-tenant to avoid noisy instrumentation. we should not send hints on every single failed attempt from a bad client. maybe 1 hint per minute per-tenant.
mira: good call. ops concerned about telemetry explosion. we'll add a sampled metric `embed.hint.issued` and `embed.hint.followed`. sampling 10% by default but higher for canary tenants.
igor: SDK-side: we'll add an opt-in auto-split helper. flow: on error code `input_shape_mismatch` or `payload_too_large` parse hint.suggested_split (e.g., [[512,512],[1024]]), then if user enabled auto_split=true, do sequential retries with exponential backoff and set header X-Embed-Split-Source: sdk.
rachael: for backwards-compat, only emit hints for clients that set `X-API-Level: 2` or newer. and gate rollout behind ff `embeds:dim_hint_v2`.
ben: console changes: small inline doc on route page, add a chart for hints issued by tenant and a small panel that lists sanitized example payload shapes. UX should offer a copyable curl showing how to split.
mira: we need an alert: if hint_followed < 10% after 24h on canary tenants -> investigate partner onboarding issue. also alert if hints per minute > 500 cluster-wide.
igor: telemetry design: emit span tag suggestion_issued=true, suggestion_type=dim_split|size_split, tenant_id=hashed. when client follows suggestion, emit suggestion_followed and correlate via X-Trace-Id if present. store counters not payloads.
rachael: rollout plan: 1) implement runtime + SDK stubs, 2) internal canary (platform) for 48h, 3) invite 2 external partners, 4) ramp gradually. feature-flag default off, 1% traffic for day 1.
ben: docs: add example code for go/python/js SDKs showing parse & fallback. make sure errors map to typed exceptions `EmbeddingShapeError` and `EmbeddingSizeError`.
mira: ops playbook: how to rollback ff, how to disable hinting per-tenant, playbook for partner outreach. include sample message to send partners explaining expected changes.
igor: one more nuance: for very large uniform-dim batches that would be okay if chunked differently (e.g., lots of small vectors) we should include `suggested_split_chunks` in hint: e.g., split_by: "count=256" rather than dims. this avoids forcing dim-based split logic in SDKs.
rachael: agreed. final API draft for hint JSON (v2): {code: "input_shape_mismatch", message: "mixed dims", hint: {kind: "dim_split", suggested_split: [ [512],[512,1024] ], max_batch_bytes: 600000, suggested_chunk_count: 128, expected_latency_delta: "+15%"}}. put this spec in the API reference.
ben: can we add a short human URL in the message: "See: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/embeds/errors#shape" so partners can click?
mira: fine as long as link is stable and not leaking infra.
ops-bot: feature-flag created: embeds:dim_hint_v2 (ff-id ff-emb-2028). scheduled canary window 2026-04-20 09:00 UTC -> 2026-04-22 09:00 UTC.
rachael: I'll spin up PRs: runtime, sdk, console. kira from partner success will coordinate partner invites. will post PR links here. :white_check_mark:
